reasons: A1: A10 proves implemented controls and training code, not measured quality improvement; no matched prior/AI comparison or verified correctness labels exist.

A2: QLoRA, deterministic rescoring, prompt versioning, experiment machinery and fail-closed gates form a credible tailored approach, but completed adaptation and comparative originality remain unproved.
A3: Two reported delivery quarters plus version, usage and A/B mechanisms support adaptability more strongly; populated histories and longitudinal reviewed outcomes are still absent.
A4: The reported 257 person-days and nested monthly task are scoped and review-aware, but the ledger, deductions, approval provenance and retained-quality comparison are missing.
A5: The paper identifies an assurance need but provides no verified assurance outcome, accessibility correction/retest, satisfaction measure or service-user benefit.
editorial_fixes: Change heading "3 Training reusable prompts and review" to "3 Training, reusable prompts and review" for grammar and parallel structure.
In the summary, replace "The account team reports 257 person-days" with "The account narrative reports 257 person-days" to match the inspected evidence source precisely.
missing_evidence: Matched quality observations with verified correctness labels and an independent model comparison.
Completed adapter identity, trainer state, conversion artefact and serving/inference linkage.
Populated version, usage and A/B histories showing sustained reviewed benefit.
Quarterly task ledger, review deductions, approval provenance, comparable timings and retained-quality evidence.
Defined 85% population and period plus verified stakeholder, assurance or accessibility outcomes.

reasons: N1: N01 demonstrates target-volume achievement and automated P90 failure detection, but four samples per transaction and no closure record limit requirements evidence.
N2: Production-informed workloads, six profiles, Kubernetes behaviour and cache-pattern reproduction strongly address representative conditions, though primary runs remain incomplete.
N3: The approach exposes release risks and is linked narratively to releases and migration decisions; acceptance records, dates, reruns and observation windows are absent.
N4: Goals, roles, resources and reusable assets are coherent, while efficiency, capacity and release achievements remain source-reported rather than primary results.
N5: Rebuilds, invalid exits, cache behaviour and missing telemetry are evaluated with specific responses; quantitative remediation and gate closure remain unverified.
editorial_fixes: Remove the paragraph beginning "AI supported the engineering of these capabilities"; its incremental contribution is unmeasured and it distracts from the non-functional criteria.
missing_evidence: Complete representative run records with transaction mix, sample populations, environment equivalence and acceptance results.
Matched cache baseline/retest measurements and telemetry-gate rerun.
Before/after timings and review effort for each reported greater-than-90% reduction.
Release dates, sign-offs, defect closure and defined post-release observation windows.
Reconciled endpoint and aggregate performance results.

reasons: I1: Domain-owned scenarios with centrally governed execution credibly advance operating practice, but active contribution and comparative benefit are unverified.
I2: The driver, ownership model, tag, generator and three-pipeline design are coherent and source-traceable; implementation records were not inspected.
I3: The transferable multi-team contribution model is a defensible attempt to push practice boundaries without requiring external adoption, but demonstrated effect is thin.
I4: Goals and resources are clear, while five-team participation, delivered implementation and achieved benefits lack primary contribution and execution records.
I5: Maintenance, setup, triage and environment constraints receive plausible design responses; no complete failure-to-owner-to-rerun example proves operation.
missing_evidence: Tagged-test inventories, contribution history and shared-suite runs for the five described teams.
Repository and execution evidence for the generator and three pipelines.
An end-to-end triage, correction and successful-rerun example.
Measured regression coverage, duplicate-maintenance reduction, cross-service defects or comparison with prior practice.

council_recommendation: A10 warrants a one-point rise in AI adaptability because it substantiates implemented versioning, usage and experiment mechanisms; AI is 12/25. It does not justify higher quality, efficiency or outcome scores because source code and stored local reports are not completed experiments, client operation or measured benefit. NFT remains 17/25 and Innovation 14/25. All papers use suitable UK English, preserve anonymity and state key limits; no privacy breach is visible in the exact text. None meets 4/5 on every criterion. Apply the small grammar and focus edits, package A10 only as hashed local implementation evidence, and seek permitted structured records rather than emails or testimonials. Keep account AI, specialist applications, PerfOps and shared regression as separate scopes.
